profile_text.body:
Amazon is a for-profit public company founded in 1994 and headquartered in Seattle, Washington, United States. Its website, amazon.com, describes it as an online shopping and entertainment destination offering free shipping on millions of items, Prime membership, and a product selection spanning fashion, home, beauty, electronics, Alexa Devices, sporting goods, toys, automotive, pets, baby, books, video games, musical instruments, office supplies, and more. The company files with the SEC.

Amazon's AI position is reflected mainly through third-party tools that connect to its seller and advertising data. These include ai.agentxray/amazon-seller-mcp, which links Amazon Seller Central and Ads into Claude or ChatGPT; ai.sellermate/amazon-ads, which lets users query an Amazon Ads account with guardrails over a remote MCP connection with OAuth; ai.trendsapi/amazon and ai.trendsmcp/amazon, which provide Amazon product search volume and demand trends; and app.apiguru/amazon-data, which supplies live product, review, search, deal, offer and stock, and seller data across 20 marketplaces.

On the legal side, the record lists a case, Haugland v. Anthropic PBC, in the District Court, D. Delaware. It also lists Washington as a jurisdiction with 114 entries under law exposure.
